712e543da3.why: The swap must also leave the original ymm0 in ymm8, so all three vector moves, the scalar load, and the flag-setting pointer increment are required.

8f77541680.why: Both independent vector swaps need temporary storage, and the required final ymm8 value prevents removing any of the six moves.

725caae3ce.why: Each vector copy produces a required register value, and the scalar load and pointer increment are independently required.

db4757c62d.why: All three vector destinations require distinct assignments, in addition to the required scalar load and pointer increment.

f619bc9472.why: The four vector moves each produce a required destination value, and neither the scalar load nor the pointer increment can be removed.

bc51c71982.why: The broadcast mask in ymm8 is a required output, so its load cannot be eliminated by folding a memory operand into the shuffle.

1b3bf85d69.why: The two vector shuffles and their shared broadcast mask all produce required outputs, alongside the scalar load and pointer increment.

08452e577b.why: AVX2 requires a separate shuffle for each of the three vector outputs, and the broadcast mask, scalar load, and pointer increment must also be preserved.

5093bcbc79.why: Each of the four vector outputs needs its own shuffle, while the broadcast mask, scalar load, and pointer increment remain required.

949018322c.why: The two full-width vector loads, scalar load, and two independent pointer increments each produce required register values.

b009f3027b.why: All four vector loads, the scalar load, and the three pointer increments are required, and AVX2 cannot combine them into fewer instructions.

db1e5705a6.why: Both 32-byte stores, the scalar load, and the pointer increment are required, and vzeroupper must preserve its observable clearing of vector upper halves.

62466fcb2f.why: All four stores and both pointer increments are required, as are the scalar load and the observable upper-half clearing by vzeroupper.

8813056960.why: After masking with ymm9, each byte is either zero or its nonzero single-bit mask. Unsigned minimum with the 0x01 bytes in ymm10 converts these to 0 or 1, replacing each comparison followed by AND.

81c0f1780a.why: The shifts and shuffles produce required vector values, both movemasks and stores are needed, and the scalar outputs and vzeroupper effects must also match.

d6210e5cbb.why: The constant vector in ymm8 is a required output, and both comparisons, the scalar load, and the pointer increment are independently necessary.

3789af1a30.why: For arbitrary input bits, each output requires both shifts and both OR operations, and AVX2 has no fused instruction that reduces this sequence while preserving the shifted temporaries.

6eea66c41f.why: The arbitrary input vectors require both shifts and both OR operations per result, with the shifted ymm1 and ymm5 values also required as outputs.

b15c9a1f5f.why: Neither pair of shifts and OR operations can be combined under AVX2 for arbitrary input values while retaining all required vector results.
